story.title: From a rainy bookshop to a summer garden
paragraphs: We met reaching for the same dog-eared cookbook on a wet Tuesday in Bristol. Theo offered it to Maya; Maya offered coffee in return. Neither of us made the recipe.
Seven years, three homes and one very opinionated spaniel later, we are gathering our favourite people for one glorious day. We cannot imagine it without you.

travel.intro: Fernhill is a ten-minute taxi from Bruton station. Trains run from London Paddington via Westbury. Please book your return taxi ahead of time.

hotels.name: The Lantern Rooms
hotels.detail: Light-filled rooms above a bookshop on Bruton's high street, with breakfast in the garden yard.

hotels.name: The Hare & Holt
hotels.detail: A relaxed country inn with six rooms and a very good Sunday breakfast.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Garden party finery. Think colour, comfortable shoes and one warm layer for after sunset. The ceremony and drinks are on grass.

faq.question: Can I bring children?
faq.answer: We adore your little ones, but our celebration will be adults-only apart from immediate family. Thank you for understanding.

faq.question: Is there parking?
faq.answer: Yes. There is a signed field beside the venue. Cars may be collected before noon on Sunday, but please do not leave valuables inside.

faq.question: What about gifts?
faq.answer: Your company is the only gift we need. If you feel strongly, a small contribution to our honeymoon train journey would be lovely.

faq.question: Who can help on the day?
faq.answer: For anything urgent, speak to our coordinator at the venue. Her name is Rosa and she will be wearing a raspberry ribbon.

footer.note: Made for one very big day
